doc: Reviewed ceiling on duplicate-excess AST nodes; the gate refuses commits above it. Lower with clone-census -update-baseline after tightening. Raised 10047 to 10206 because converting 1120 distinct classic numeric loop headers to the uniform Go integer-range form removed 3572 runtime AST nodes while making four existing kernel-loop shapes normalize as clone groups. Raised 10206 to 10431 because 152 exact fallback, ticker, clone, and typed-sort rewrites normalized formerly distinct control flow into shared standard-library forms while the complete manual sweep lowered measured modern-Go candidates from 743 to 581; no production surface was added. Raised 10431 to 10441 for two five-node immutable identity accessors on the new mechanism census and candidate values; the apparent Content duplication is already delegate-exempt, and replacing the accessors with exported mutable fields or an identity wrapper would weaken the contracts solely to alter the metric. Raised 10441 to 10464 for two independent 23-node test ratchets that prove forbidden state fields remain absent from unrelated production contracts; a shared exported reflection helper lowered the number but was correctly refused as a new test-only production surface, and no production clone group increased.
